policy.title: Policy
policy.intro: This policy explains the rules for using Ilna and how we handle your information. By using Ilna you agree to it.

sections.title: Who Ilna is for
body: Ilna is a study platform for university students. You need a university email address to create an account, and each person may have only one account.

sections.title: Your account
body: Your name, username, email, university, college and major are set when you sign up and can't be changed later. Make sure they are correct.
You can change your password at any time from Settings. Keep it private; you are responsible for activity on your account.

sections.title: Community rules
body: Be respectful. Harassment, hate speech, threats, sharing other people's personal information, spam and illegal content are not allowed.
Respect academic integrity. Don't use Ilna to share exam answers or help others cheat.
Posts in the university, college and major blogs are visible to other students in that group. Posts in General are visible to all Ilna users.

sections.title: Your posts and replies
body: You own what you write. By posting, you allow Ilna to display your content to the users who can see that blog.
You can delete your own posts and replies. A deleted reply that others have answered stays as a "[deleted]" placeholder so the conversation still makes sense.

sections.title: Uploaded files
body: Only upload files you have the right to share, such as your own notes or materials your course allows you to use.
Each account has a storage limit of 1 GB.

Summaries and quizzes are written from your files, recordings and notes by an AI service provided by Google (Gemini). You can make up to 2 summaries and 2 quizzes in any 24 hours. AI-generated content can contain mistakes, so always check it against your course materials.

sections.title: Your information
body: We store the details you give at sign-up, the content you post and the files you upload.
Other users can see your name, username, avatar, posts and replies. Your email address is not shown to other users.
We don't sell your personal information.

sections.title: Enforcement
body: We may remove content or suspend accounts that break this policy.

sections.title: Changes and contact
body: We may update this policy. When we do, we'll change the date at the top of this page.
Questions? Use Contact us in Settings.
